name: Contrabass Line
description: The bass section alone, contrabass and cello, short and dry for a line.

name: Brass Ensemble
description: Trumpet and horn through the ensemble, a quick swell.

name: Horns and Strings
description: The horn tab over the viola and the cello, a medium swell: a soft horn section doubled by strings, for held chords.

name: Trumpet Line
description: The trumpet tab alone with a quick swell and a little delayed vibrato: a bright, buzzing line for a melody.

name: Choir and Strings
description: The choir over violin and viola and the cello below, a slow swell and a long release: a lush pad for a ballad's chorus.

name: Slow Choir
description: The choir over the viola, swelling slowly, a touch of vibrato.

name: Classic Strings
description: The string machine pad: violin and viola, a long swell and release, the ensemble wide.

name: Dry Divider
description: The ensemble off: the machine's raw divider saws, bright and still, nearer an organ than strings.

name: Full Orchestra
description: Every string at once, contrabass and cello under violin and viola, swelling in.

name: Init
description: Violin and viola over the cello, a slow swell, the ensemble on in stereo.

name: Mono Ensemble
description: The ensemble's mono output: the chorus's movement without its width, as the early machines gave it.

name: Space Wash
description: The longest swell and release with the whole section: a slow wash of strings for space rock and ambient.

name: Tremolo Pad
description: Violin and viola through a square-wave tremolo at a medium speed: a pad that pulses in time.

name: Disco Strings
description: Violin and viola with almost no swell and a short release, the ensemble wide: the quick, bright string stabs and runs of a disco record.

name: Vibrato Strings
description: Violin and viola with a vibrato that waits a moment after the first key and fades in: held chords that come alive.

name: Viola Section
description: The viola alone through the ensemble: darker and warmer than the violins, for chords in the middle.

name: Violins High
description: The violin alone, an octave over the viola, with a medium swell: a thin, high line over a band.
